high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in a room with light-colored walls and a white baseboard. The individual is wearing a plaid button-up shirt with ruffled details at the collar and chest area. They have on black shorts that are slightly pulled down, revealing a small portion of their underwear.
